newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche details 1996 results under IAS.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche details 1996 results under IAS.

text.p: Deutsche Bank published the following 1996 results in
(in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Group oper profit after risk provs
Group net interest income before provs10,500 vs 10,800
Group net interest income after provs 9,700 vs 9,400
Pre-tax return on equity 17.1 vs 13.7 pct
Group net profit per share 4.25 dmk vs 4.15 dmk

NOTE - Full name of the German bank is Deutsche Bank AG. The above results and their 1995 comparisons are in accordance with International Accounting Standards (IAS). Deutsche already reported net and operating profit and its dividend. Chief executive Hilmar Kopper said in a statement that 1996 was a good year on the whole but had some difficulties. Trading profit grew due to the build up of investment banking business and the contribution of trading profit to regular income tripled to 15 percent over the past three years. The rise in income taxes was due to a substantial rise in deferred taxes reprted under IAS and profit advances which were subject to high taxes. The extraordinary expense in London resulted in only moderate tax relief.
